E2703

`E2703: {detail}`

What

`E2703: {detail}`

Why

The checked formatter accepts one closed token grammar so a typo cannot silently become literal output, and zone fields cannot claim context that the value does not carry.

Fix

Close the quoted literal, complete or correct the `%` escape, choose a supported token, or format a `ZonedDateTime` when the token needs a zone.
